meaning.scope: Proposed gross purchase-time caller-paid WETH18/DTF18 token quantities, not approved original NFT cost.
meaning.firstFullBook: Extra DTF is actually caller-paid non-leading reserve/protocol capital. Its quantity is nonzero; it is not added to approved original NFT cost.
meaning.zeroMeaning: No caller debit of the other named ERC20 component on this successful source-bound live purchase; not zero native cost, prior credit or financial exposure.
meaning.approvedOriginalCost: unknown for every row; source role and economic/financial approval remain separate
